USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
INSERT INTO team_f_db.development.question_pool (QUESTION_TYPE, QUESTION_TEXT, ANSWER_PCT, DENOMINATOR_CNT, NUMERATOR_CNT)

-- 型1: 性別構成（カテゴリL1の購入者のうち男性の割合）
SELECT 'GENDER_COMPOSITION',
       CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'の購入者のうち、男性の割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '男性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2),
       COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '男性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
   AND ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '男性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95

UNION ALL

-- 型2: 性別構成（カテゴリL1の購入者のうち女性の割合）
SELECT 'GENDER_COMPOSITION',
       CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'の購入者のうち、女性の割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '女性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2),
       COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '女性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
   AND ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN GENDER_NAME = '女性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95

UNION ALL

-- 型3: 年代構成（カテゴリL1の購入者のうち特定年代の割合）
SELECT 'AGE_COMPOSITION',
       cat_age.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'の購入者のうち、' || cat_age.AGE_CATEGORY || 'の割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * cat_age.cnt / cat_total.total_cnt, 2),
       cat_total.total_cnt,
       cat_age.cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, AGE_CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, AGE_CATEGORY
) cat_age
JOIN (
  SELECT CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL AND AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
) cat_total ON cat_age.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 = cat_total.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
WHERE ROUND(100.0 * cat_age.cnt / cat_total.total_cnt, 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95

UNION ALL

-- 型4: プライム会員（カテゴリL1のうちプライム会員の割合）
SELECT 'PRIME_MEMBER',
       CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'の購入者のうち、プライム会員の割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PRIME_CUSTOMER = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2),
       COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PRIME_CUSTOMER = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
WHERE CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
   AND ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PRIME_CUSTOMER = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95

UNION ALL

-- 型5: 属性×カテゴリ（年代性別でのカテゴリL1の割合）
SELECT 'ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY',
       ag.AGE_CATEGORY || 'の' || ag.GENDER_NAME || 'の購入のうち、' || ag.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'が占める割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * ag.cnt / ag_total.total_cnt, 2),
       ag_total.total_cnt,
       ag.cnt
FROM (
  SELECT AGE_CATEGORY, GENDER_NAME, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AGE_CATEGORY, GENDER_NAME, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
) ag
JOIN (
  SELECT AGE_CATEGORY, GENDER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE AGE_CATEGORY IS NOT NULL AND GENDER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AGE_CATEGORY, GENDER_NAME
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
) ag_total ON ag.AGE_CATEGORY = ag_total.AGE_CATEGORY AND ag.GENDER_NAME = ag_total.GENDER_NAME
WHERE ROUND(100.0 * ag.cnt / ag_total.total_cnt, 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95

UNION ALL

-- 型6: 地域×カテゴリ
SELECT 'REGION_CATEGORY',
       rc.REGION || '地方の購入のうち、' || rc.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'が占める割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * rc.cnt / rc_total.total_cnt, 2),
       rc_total.total_cnt,
       rc.cnt
FROM (
  SELECT REGION, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE REGION IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY REGION, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
) rc
JOIN (
  SELECT REGION, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE REGION IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY REGION
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
) rc_total ON rc.REGION = rc_total.REGION
WHERE ROUND(100.0 * rc.cnt / rc_total.total_cnt, 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95

UNION ALL

-- 型7: 職業×カテゴリ
SELECT 'OCCUPATION_CATEGORY',
       oc.OCCUPATION_NAME || 'の購入のうち、' || oc.CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 || 'が占める割合は？',
       ROUND(100.0 * oc.cnt / oc_total.total_cnt, 2),
       oc_total.total_cnt,
       oc.cnt
FROM (
  SELECT OCCUPATION_NAME, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE OCCUPATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OCCUPATION_NAME, CATEGORY_LEVEL_1
) oc
JOIN (
  SELECT OCCUPATION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM team_f_db.development.rakuten_purchase_mart_v2
  WHERE OCCUPATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_LEVEL_1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OCCUPATION_NAME
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
) oc_total ON oc.OCCUPATION_NAME = oc_total.OCCUPATION_NAME
WHERE ROUND(100.0 * oc.cnt / oc_total.total_cnt, 2) BETWEEN 5 AND 95
